classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Standard: Apply to a container (XContainer or XFieldSet) to wrap it in a collapsible panel with shaded header that changes color when unfolded.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Flat: Apply to a container to wrap it in a flat (no shading) collapsible panel.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Minimal: Apply to a container to wrap it in a minimal collapsible panel.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Index: Apply to a container to add an index/anchor navigation panel.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_NoCordion: Apply to a container inside an accordion group to exclude it from accordion behavior.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_A: Apply to a container to set up accordion group A. Panels with the same accordion letter will fold/unfold together.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_B: Apply to a container to set up accordion group B.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_C: Apply to a container to set up accordion group C.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_D: Apply to a container to set up accordion group D.
